status_basis: F1 is closed: I have now read all 13 listed browser screenshots. They show one blocking presentation defect (F2). It is in documentary_parallel, in both the PDF and the HTML, and the HTML pointed me to the PDF page I had not inspected in full. There are also three lower-severity HTML/PDF findings (F3–F5). This is not a new source review: source, order, semantics and restoration approvals stay as they were.

closed.resolution: Exact paths came from /tmp/day2-final-html-screenshot-manifest.json. I read all 13 PNGs (listed below). The review-completeness gap is closed.

findings.severity: blocking (medium): heading and content placement / reading order
findings.detail: The English section heading 'Prayers' and its rubric 'On entering the Synagogue:' come before the end of the Hebrew Tallit section. The Hebrew-only 'יְהִי רָצוֹן … אָמֵן' and the rubric 'One then removes the טלית from the face …' then appear under 'Prayers'. After them come 'תְּפִלּוֹת.' and a second 'On entering the Synagogue:'. The PDF prints this order as full-width blocks. HTML wide places 'Prayers / On entering the Synagogue:' in the English column level with the Hebrew Tallit ending, and the mobile view gives the same order. Leaving the Hebrew-only passage unpaired is fine and intended. The problem is where it sits: a reader would take the end of the Tallit section as part of 'Prayers'. That breaks the guide's rule that a structural heading must contain the text it titles. For comparison, the expanded profile orders this correctly: expanded/page-04 and browser-wide show 'One then removes…', then 'תְּפִלּוֹת.' with the 'Prayers' subtitle, then the rubric.
findings.required_action: Place the unpaired Hebrew remainder of the previous section (and its rubric) before the next section's English heading. Then re-render documentary_parallel PDF and HTML and refresh the frozen manifest.

findings.detail: In the first row after 'תְּפִלּוֹת.', the English verse '8 And I through the abundance of Thy grace enter Thy house and bow down' is followed by an empty line before 'before Thy holy place in awe of Thee.', and there is further empty space before the next row. The same verse renders continuously in documentary_parallel/browser-wide.png and in expanded/page-04.png. This looks like an empty fragment or a marker-only row inside the PDF parallel row. There is no clipping.

On narrow screens, empty parallel rows show up as stacked divider lines with no text: 2–4 rules after '8 And I through…', after 'In the house of God…' and after '5 How becoming…' in expanded, and similar rows around 'One then drapes oneself…' in documentary_parallel. On wide screens they only add extra vertical space. The guide says 'do not manufacture empty parallel rows'. Content is complete and there is no overflow.

In the HTML, combined bilingual labels have no separator, so the bidirectional text reorders badly. Expanded shows 'On Shabbatבשבת'. Night shows 'Reader::פאַרבעטער', 'Congregation::קו״ח' and 'Congregation::געמיינדע', with doubled colons. The PDF keeps the two languages apart (expanded/page-18 shows 'בשבת   On Shabbat'). The night labels are regression material and may predate this installment.
